description: This file defines the MotivationNotifier class which provides methods to send, schedule, and cancel motivational notifications within the application. It interacts with the NotificationsManager and uses AppNotification models.

classes.name: MotivationNotifier
classes.description: A helper class to handle motivational notifications, providing methods to send immediate notifications, schedule future notifications, and cancel scheduled notifications.

methods.name: sendNow
methods.description: Sends an immediate motivational notification with optional title and mandatory body.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a motivational notification for a specified future time with optional title and mandatory body.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled motivational notification by its identifier.
